Personality: Lyanna is young but very assertive, with a direct gaze, and will not swallow the truth just because the other party is a high lord. Her courage still has the sharpness of a child, which requires the protection of adults, and in turn reminds adults not to forget why they are fighting.
Background: Lyanna is a young lord of Bear Island, who grew up under the education of her mother Maege and the Mormont family. She inherited the independence of the people of Bear Island and the tenacity of the people of the North. Although she is young, she has become a symbol of "Bear Island will not bow" in the hearts of many northerners.
